text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-035 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-035 already tested push notifications with live driver tracking and shipped. It found a Contact Rate reduction of 7% and fatigue after the third push, with a learning to cap pushes at two per order. The proposal neither references nor applies this.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035, explain what is new, apply the cap of two pushes per order, and reset the expected effect based on the prior result."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 35% reduction claim","detail":"The 35% cut in where-is-my-order contacts is stated as fact without a source. It also conflicts with the 7% reduction in EXP-035 and with the proposal's own target of 8.4 to 7.0, which is about 17%.","evidence_quote":"This will cut where-is-my-order contacts by 35%.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Remove the claim or cite a source, and align it with prior experiment results and the stated target."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days","detail":"The plan runs 3 weeks, which meets the 14-day minimum, but the proposal's success target is measured over 8 weeks while the test lasts only 3, so the target timeframe cannot be validated by the test. The claim that the experiment validates the 8-week target is therefore unsupported.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Align the experiment duration with the target timeframe, or restate the target to match the test window."}]}
